verdict.rationale: An office suite with AI features could plausibly act as an MCP client, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents only CLI start parameters, the UNO API in headless mode, macros and an extension SDK. None of it shows LibreOffice connecting to MCP servers or using their tools. The extension SDK and UNO API are developer building blocks, not a shipped MCP-client capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
